authority: Reviewed source responsibilities for the 461 selected Scala files. The seed supplies hashes and declaration inventory; historical rewrite/provenance mappings are routing hints only and grant no implementation credit.

classification_definitions.HARDWARE_BEHAVIOR: Sequential or combinational hardware behavior to be represented by Python/Amaranth and later behavior-verified.
classification_definitions.ELABORATION_CONFIG: A source-owned legal parameter, protocol selection, wrapper topology, or generated hardware mode. Every named mode remains planned even when unused by DefaultConfig.
classification_definitions.HOST_TOOL: Build, code-generation, logging, test, or simulation host behavior that has no standalone hardware implementation. Its environment contract is recorded explicitly.
classification_definitions.TEST_ONLY: A test, agent, scoreboard, or vector generator. It is a later direct-test obligation and receives no Build implementation credit.
classification_definitions.DECLARATION_SUPPORT: Bundle, enum, parameter, or helper declarations that shape a hardware family ABI or equations and must be consumed by that family.
classification_definitions.MIXED_HARDWARE_SUPPORT: A source combines hardware, elaboration, test, or host behavior; the row records each obligation and does not discard the file.

targets.responsibility: Scalar YunSuan conversion, format selection, rounding, and scalar FPU control. Current file presence does not establish full source coverage or behavior.
required_configuration_modes: full versus lite helper selection where consumed

targets.responsibility: Vector integer/floating arithmetic, conversion, reductions, permutation, iterative divide/square-root, and vector control support. The vector source set remains pending a source-derived behavior inventory.

New aggregate for the distinct YunSuan full-FPU and fpulite source families; preserve each implementation variant and its own latency/rounding behavior instead of folding them into a generic vector boundary.
required_configuration_modes: rounding, exceptional values, divide and square-root iterations

targets.responsibility: Shared utility API and configuration records used by the external families; this target is not blanket credit for the 62 Utility source files.
Bit extraction, masks, one-hot/prefix selection, priority/parallel mux, lookup, and signed/unsigned field helpers.
Hold, delay, pipeline, register-slice, latency, and valid/ready state helpers.
Queue, circular pointer, arbitration, SRAM-backed queue and MBIST pipeline/control families.

Remaining source-backed utility behavior including ECC, memory templates, CAM, clock/reset control, replacement, register maps, and performance counter state. Host macros and generated files are separately classified.
OpenLLC CHI cache pipeline: request classification, directory/coherence transitions, refill/data storage, memory/response/snoop units, multi-bank parent wiring and sideband status.
required_configuration_modes: CHI issue variant and RN/SN counts

targets.responsibility: OpenLLC CHI TX/RX channel adapters, flit packing, ready/valid transfers, link activation, and credit accounting.
The 89-file OpenNCB family: AXI4 and CHI channel ABI, transaction ID/order/age/free-list state, request/data/response queues, burst conversion, and link-credit control.
required_configuration_modes: CHI Issue encoding and flit widths
AXI read/write ordering and burst lengths

targets.responsibility: OpenLLC bank routing, MMIO transaction-ID divergence/merge, TargetBinder elaboration, and synchronous SRAM read/write forwarding.
Shared HuanCun cache path: TileLink A-E traffic, directory/data storage, source/sink control, refill, prefetch, ECC/DFT and shared queue helpers.
Inclusive HuanCun directory/MSHR/SinkC transaction family, including allocation, retained source/address, refill completion, release/probe and cancellation.
Non-inclusive HuanCun directory/MSHR/probe helper/slice control bridge, with probe/snoop ordering and TileLink handshakes.
Fudian floating-point add/compare/multiply/FMA/divide/square-root/conversion and rounding family.
required_configuration_modes: iterative divide/square-root state and pipeline latency

targets.responsibility: Fudian shared CLZ, carry-save adder, leading-zero anticipation, multiplier and shift-right-jam arithmetic helpers.
Difftest hardware-facing ABI and real trace/control transactions. DPI software callbacks require the separate Runtime-Hdl contract and cannot be represented by an output-less or zero-value RTL shell.
required_configuration_modes: trace FIFO depth, overflow, reset and backpressure
AXI/AXI-lite interface widths and outstanding transactions

targets.responsibility: Difftest commit, architectural state, event, batching, delta, replay, squash, trace, and top-down stateful endpoints. Current CONTRACT_ONLY members remain pending real state equations and direct/reference evidence.

Shared source-backed CoupledL2 transaction records, storage/prefetch/monitor helpers and common slice behavior. It is a reusable child family; parent topology and the TL2TL/CHI protocol engines have separate Build targets.
New CoupledL2 parent Build for the BaseSlice/CoupledL2 wrapper path; selects and wires the common, Directory, TL2TL and CHI family APIs through controller injection.
required_configuration_modes: bank count/slice ID and L1 client geometry
L2 flush, async source-ready and optional monitor/DFT wiring

targets.responsibility: CoupledL2 tag/meta directory lookup, replacement selection, reset scrub, refill retry/occupied-way exclusion, ECC and MBIST/DFT access.
CoupledL2 CHI message layouts and TL2CHI adapter, link activation/credit accounting, CHI RX/TX channel state, MMIO bridge, MSHR, snoop and slice behavior.
New TileLink-to-TileLink CoupledL2 protocol family aggregate; separates Acquire/MainPipe/MSHR/ProbeQueue/Refill/SinkB/SourceC state from the broad common Slice boundary.
required_configuration_modes: TileLink A-E opcode/size/source and beat geometry
SinkB probe backpressure and SourceC release beats
directory retry, flush and refill response

targets.responsibility: ChiselIOPMP register/config table, request checking and AXI bridge; preserve APB setup/access, range matching, permission/error reports and interrupt behavior despite absence from the selected top.
required_configuration_modes: APB register widths and write-one semantics
NA4/NAPOT range modes and partial/full address overlap

targets.responsibility: APLIC/IMSIC hardware and both source-owned TileLink and AXI4 topologies. The existing compact register boundary is only a starting candidate; it does not cover the six Scala files by itself.
required_configuration_modes: IMSIC M/S/guest files and TEE enabled/disabled

runtime_targets.responsibility: Pure-standard-library deterministic trace/DPI endpoint contract: event schema, callback registration/dispatch, reset and enable gates, event order, bounded queues/backpressure and explicit missing-endpoint errors. It does not rewrite or claim compatibility with external C++ implementations.
required_configuration_modes: bounded trace queue and overflow policy
external C++/DPI function names remain an explicit environment contract

routes.reason: YunSuan Scala test vectors, wrappers and test tops are retained as explicit Python direct-test cases; any Chisel helper in the same source remains a separate fixture obligation.
features: Preserve conversion, arithmetic, permutation, divide and pipeline test scenarios as deterministic direct Python cases; retain full-FPU versus fpulite and all selected vector operation families.

routes.reason: Opcode, vector element format, operand type and operation tables define legal hardware modes and bundle ABI consumed by the YunSuan families.
features: Preserve every opcode/type encoding, f16/f32/f64 format, signedness, lane/SEW selection and bundle field width; configuration tables must affect generated equations.

routes.reason: Scalar conversion, rounding and format helpers contain source-owned data paths and control used by the scalar floating-point family.
features: IntToFP and FP conversion sign/width/normalization paths; rounding mode and exceptional-value handling; valid/enable timing.

routes.reason: The full and fpulite packages contain separate adder, divider, FMA and square-root modules with source-defined pipeline state.
features: Keep fpu and fpulite variants distinct; preserve floating formats, iterative quotient/root selection, rounding/flags and each register-enable/latency boundary.

routes.reason: Vector source packages implement ALU, conversion, floating arithmetic, integer divide, permutation, and vector control datapaths.
features: Preserve SEW/lane and mask/vstart/vl branches; ALU/reduction carry and saturation; conversion rounding; gather/slide/compress overlap; iterative divider/root state and backpressure.

routes.reason: Shared bit, mask, selection, lookup and clock-enable helpers feed several YunSuan families and therefore belong to their explicit injected support closure.
features: Preserve width/signedness, one-hot and priority order, mask boundaries, clock-enable holds, and each consuming family’s exact helper subset.

routes.reason: The SRAMTemplate Scala test source defines host test cases and possible hardware fixtures; retain fixture versus oracle responsibilities separately.
features: Preserve single/dual-port and folded SRAM transaction vectors, read latency, write masks, collision behavior and test topology as direct Python tests.

routes.reason: These sources parse/extract emitted Verilog, register/write generated files, or emit MBIST CSV metadata. They do not define standalone hardware and must not be copied into a Build or treated as RTL coverage.
features: Record CLI/file/output naming and generated metadata needs in the auxiliary/controller contract; Amaranth same-name export and explicit Build configuration replace product-side HDL extraction; MBIST functional bus/pipeline remains in Utility Build families.

routes.reason: These files combine event/record bundle and trigger logic with DPI-C, C++/SQLite, file or CHI-log host endpoints.
features: Preserve hardware event fields, clock/reset/en/negedge and record ordering in Build/runtime contracts; keep C++/SQLite implementations outside this rewrite scope and raise an explicit missing-endpoint error instead of returning fake values.

routes.reason: These utility modules provide combinational bit/mask extraction, lookup, parallel and priority selection used by dependent families.
features: Preserve index boundaries, priority versus parallel selection, default/no-hit behavior, unsigned/signed widths and zero-width corner cases.

routes.reason: These helpers implement cycle delay, hold/bypass, pipeline and registered ready/valid state.
features: Preserve flow/pipe behavior, ready/valid backpressure, simultaneous transfer, reset values, requested latency and hold semantics.

routes.reason: These sources define arbiter/queue/pointer or MBIST control state and sequencing.
features: Preserve pointer wrap/full-empty distinctions, enqueue/dequeue collision, arbitration fairness/priority and held grants; MBIST request routing, pipeline latency and clock-gate test control.

routes.reason: Package and compatibility declarations are compile-time/public support used by utility clients and must be represented explicitly without porting Scala runtime identity.
features: Preserve only consumed public fields, names, parameter defaults and type relationships; validate all dependent family consumers.

routes.reason: The group mixes counters, error/reset/clock control hardware with compile-time/debug/measurement helpers.
features: Preserve counter increment/clear/saturation, reset and clock/test-enable behavior; classify compile-time log/measurement macros as non-RTL host support with Amaranth-side replacement notes.

routes.reason: Remaining Utility modules are mapped to the residual source-backed family; each declaration still receives its own owner and its own hardware/config/host feature obligations.
features: Review actual source equations for ECC, SRAM/DataModuleTemplate, CAM, RegMap, replacement, logging/perf helper and Diplomacy/TileLink boundary; do not infer completion from this aggregate name.

routes.reason: OpenLLC/OpenNCB test tops are host elaboration and test fixtures; any module declared in the test source remains fixture-only and cannot become product behavior by inclusion.
features: Retain OpenLLC L3/SoC topology, NCB200 AXI/CHI branch, IDs/addresses and test modes as direct-test configurations; separate generator App behavior from Build.

routes.reason: The nested OpenNCB source closure declares AXI/CHI data shapes and stateful transaction/ordering/channel machinery.
features: AXI AR/AW/W/B/R handshake and burst conversion; CHI REQ/RSP/DAT/SNP flit packing; transaction ID allocation/free/order/age/payload; link-active and L-Credit pool state; backpressure and reset.

routes.reason: OpenLLC CHI channel files define RN/SN flit boundaries and per-channel link/valid/credit behavior consumed by the cache parent.
features: Preserve TX/RX channel direction, flit width, reset/link-active state, credit return and channel backpressure; Cache consumes this public family by controller injection.

routes.reason: OpenLLC routing/MMIO helper sources contain hardware routing plus topology/elaboration support consumed by the cache parent.
features: Preserve bank/address routing, MMIO ID separation/merge, request ordering, SRAM timing and TargetBinder-selected node topology.

routes.reason: OpenLLC cache sources implement a multi-stage CHI LLC, directory, data/refill/memory/response/snoop units, and configurable parent composition.
features: Five-stage MainPipe CHI opcode/coherence updates; valid/dirty/client directory and replacement; refill beats/data storage; MSHR/transaction-ID matching; snoop conflict/CompAck ordering; 4-bank xbar/MMIO/link integration and l3Miss/top-down status.

routes.reason: HuanCun tests include TileLink agents, fake clients, system tops and generators; source hardware helpers must remain explicit fixtures, not be dropped with test classification.
features: Retain acquire/release/probe/refill, directory conflict, allocator/data storage, inclusive/non-inclusive and ExampleSystem configurations as direct Python cases.

routes.reason: Inclusive Directory/MSHR/SinkC sources implement stateful directory and release/refill response handling.
features: Allocate and retain request source/address; source-matched refill/release completion; valid/dirty/client state; probe/flush and response backpressure.

routes.reason: Non-inclusive Directory/MSHR/ProbeHelper/SinkC/SliceCtrl files own a separate probe/snoop transaction path.
features: Probe conflict and source match, non-inclusive metadata, request/probe ordering, valid/ready hold, retry/flush and returned response state.

routes.reason: These files define HuanCun cache geometry, shared metadata/field records and SRAM annotations which select generated hardware variants.
features: Preserve legal cache geometry, inclusion mode, ECC/data-check, SRAM/MBIST selection and annotation-to-generated-memory contract.

routes.reason: Shared HuanCun source modules define TileLink channel, cache storage, refill, arbitration, prefetch, monitoring and shared helpers.
features: TileLink A-E handshake/order; directory and data memory timing; refill/evict/probe transactions; prefetch valid/metadata; performance/debug outputs; ECC/poison/MBIST options.

routes.reason: Fudian source tests include FCMA vectors, argument parsing and a generation top; test and elaboration behavior stay explicit.
features: Retain FCMA and arithmetic corner vectors, command/config options, format and generated-top modes as Python direct tests.

routes.reason: The shared utility sources contain real normalizer, CSA, multiplier and sticky-shift arithmetic used by Fudian operations.
features: Preserve carry propagation, leading-zero detection/anticipation, multiplier products, sticky/jam shift and exact widths; FPU consumes helper behavior through injection.

routes.reason: Fudian main sources contain pipelined FADD/FCMA/FCMP/FDIV/FMUL/conversion and rounding modules plus their public data shapes.
features: Preserve f16/f32/f64 datapaths, exception flags, rounding/tininess, normal/subnormal/NaN/Inf/zero paths, FMA and iterative divide/sqrt latency.

routes.reason: DifftestTop/Main are simulation/elaboration fixtures and must become explicit tests without turning simulator plumbing into zero-output product hardware.
features: Preserve trace/commit and host-control top configurations; external DPI/C++ callback implementations remain an environment contract.

routes.reason: These sources are coverage/validation, file, profile/query or elaboration wiring utilities. They are host-side responsibilities, not standalone RTL Build behavior.
features: Keep command/file/environment behavior explicit in auxiliary validation or controller configuration; do not add an empty Amaranth module or claim CPU functionality from host code.

routes.reason: Architectural payload definitions and Difftest/Batch/Delta/Squash endpoints mix exact data contracts with stateful queues/register behavior.
features: Enumerate every event/state payload field and core/index/stamp/enable variant; preserve capture enables, batch/delta ordering, squash state and exact reset/hold semantics.

routes.reason: These sources define memory/AXI/FPGA/top interfaces with simulation-host configuration and external-device boundaries.
features: Preserve AXI/AXI-lite/stream directions and IDs, burst/response ordering, memory initialization/read/write semantics, flash/SD-card endpoint ABI and FPGA versus simulation topology.

routes.reason: These sources contain real trace/replay/top-down port/state contracts and simulator DPI/host callbacks. Runtime duties are separated into Runtime-Hdl-UHSC.Trace.
features: Keep the RTL payload/clock/reset/enable and handshake contract; Runtime-Hdl preserves deterministic callback registration/order and explicit missing-handler errors; external C++ implementations stay out of this rewrite scope.

routes.reason: Difftest utility sources implement timing, lookup and decoupled skid/pipeline state supporting endpoint families.
features: Preserve configured delay, data/valid alignment, reset, same-cycle bypass, skid full/empty and ready/valid backpressure.

routes.reason: Remaining Difftest source declarations are explicitly mapped to the interface/state families pending per-symbol review; their host/debug use is not product behavior by default.
features: Classify each declared module/bundle/helper by actual state and observable ports; preserve mode-specific behavior and retain any unproven member as pending, never as zero-output RTL.

routes.reason: CoupledL2 tests include A-E protocol agents, queue/SRAM fixtures and TL/CHI generation tops; every hardware helper remains a separate fixture obligation.
features: Retain Acquire/Release/Probe/Grant, SourceC beats, queue conflicts, SRAM behavior, bank/config and both TL2TL and CHI parent modes as direct tests.

routes.reason: The CHI branch has independent message/opcode, link, credit, RX/TX, MSHR, snoop, MMIO and slice state; it remains required although DefaultConfig may select TL2TL.
features: CHI REQ/RSP/DAT/SNP field/opcode encodings; STOP/ACTIVATE/RUN/DEACTIVATE; L-Credit pool/return; async crossing; channel backpressure, MSHR/snoop and MMIO completion.

routes.reason: The TileLink implementation is a separate protocol family; its Acquire, MainPipe, MSHR/control, ProbeQueue, refill, SinkB, SourceC and wrapper files are not covered by the Directory target.
features: A-E request/release/probe/grant handshakes; MSHR allocation/selection; retry/refill and dirty metadata; probe queue backpressure; SourceC multi-beat release and SinkB conflict; reset/flush.

routes.reason: This source implements set/way tag and metadata directory lookup, replacement, reset scrub, occupied-way and refill retry behavior.
features: Tag/meta read latency, valid/state/client/alias/prefetch/error fields, invalid-way/replacement select, MSHR occupancy exclusion, refill retry, CMO and ECC/MBIST writes.

routes.reason: Common parameter and transaction records are source-backed shared inputs to the Slice/Directory/TL2TL/CHI families, provided through explicit configuration/API contracts.
features: sets/ways/beat/bank/MSHR, ECC/data-check, MBIST, prefetch, flush, monitor and EnableCHI branches; preserve all selected public fields and legal parameter ranges.

routes.reason: BaseSlice and CoupledL2 define the parent wrapper/hierarchy and choose the TileLink or CHI implementation branch.
features: Preserve BaseSlice public A-E and optional prefetch/error/flush/status ports; instantiate the selected TL2TL or TL2CHI family and keep bank/slice IDs, reset and config wiring explicit.

routes.reason: Shared CoupledL2 storage, request, sink/source, prefetch, debug and SRAM/replacement helpers form a source-backed reusable support family.
features: Preserve data/metadata ECC and SRAM read/write collision behavior, prefetch training/metadata, request/source queues, monitor/debug counters, throttle and replacement modes.

routes.reason: IopmpChecker is a stateful register/table and access-checking datapath, not just an interface declaration.
features: Register read/write/W1C semantics; source/domain config tables; NA4/NAPOT address match/full/partial/no match and entry priority; read/write permission and no-write checks; error capture/address/id/type, stall/flush, enable and interrupt.

routes.reason: IopmpBridge implements APB-to-register setup/access and AXI request filtering/error response state.
features: AR/AW outstanding queues, fair read/write checker polling, length/address/id retention, pass-through disable path, error R/B FSM, outstanding-ahead counters and response-channel backpressure.

routes.reason: The source combines Req/Rsp arbiters, LazyModule wrappers/AXI nodes and an App-style Verilog generator.
features: Preserve one/multi-bridge arbitration and node topology; keep the generator as auxiliary configuration tooling and implement the checker/bridge behavior as actual Amaranth logic.

routes.reason: IMSIC parameters select hart/group mapping and interrupt-file geometry consumed by both topologies.
features: Preserve M/S/guest file enable, base addresses, group/member/hart index mapping, stride and legal geometry.

routes.reason: Common bridges contain AXI4-to-lite burst/state control, AXI4Map, AXI4-to-TileLink ordering and TL/AXI register-mapper behavior.
features: Preserve AW/W split arrival, burst last/count, ID/echo retention, illegal transfer handling, read/write arbitration, TL source/size restore, denied/corrupt response and backpressure.

routes.reason: IMSIC defines register decoding, interrupt-file storage/gateway and TileLink/AXI wrappers with optional security and asynchronous support.
features: M/S/guest pending-enable-claim-complete state, privilege/operation decode, gateway pending/edge behavior, multi-hart files, TEE/security gates, reset and bus transaction ordering.

routes.reason: APLIC source implements source configuration/synchronization/delegation, per-source pending and target programming, domain logic and MSI delivery.
features: Edge/level polarity and synchronization, domain enable, sourcecfg/target/priority/threshold, pending/enable/claim, group/member routing and MSI address/EIID generation.

routes.reason: TLAIA is a real TileLink example hierarchy with two IMSIC groups, two members per group, address maps and APLIC wiring.
features: Retain TLAIA node topology, four-hart map, IMSIC/APLIC parameters, CSR ports, intSrcs and reset/clock wiring; generator App stays out of Build.

routes.reason: AXI4AIA is a separate AXI4 hierarchy and selects the asynchronous IMSIC bridge; it is required independently of the TL example.
features: Retain AXI4Xbar/address maps, async bridge, four IMSIC members, APLIC path, TEE/security wires and CSR/external interrupt wiring; do not mark unsupported or replace with all-zero outputs.
